pages.text: The server is $(l)mc.wmiddleton.com$(). Voice chat is built in: $(l)V$() opens its menu (pick push-to-talk or voice activation there), $(l)`$() makes groups.

Stuck? Type $(l)!ask$() and your question in chat ("!ask how do I get titanite?") and a helper answers; start with $(l)!resume$() to reply to it. Verity answers too, if you say its name, but Verity has its own ideas.
The pack updates itself every time you press Play, and never touches your settings. Don't use your launcher's mod-update buttons on it.
